column1: # Benchmark genomes: downloaded once into data/<name>/<file> and checked against sha256.
# reps: default number of timed runs per program. bytes: size of the download. length: sequence
# characters including N; acgt: A, C, G and T (either case) on one strand.
# The spruce assembly is Pabies1.0 (Nystedt et al. 2013), as distributed by the Spruce Genome Project
# (congenie.org, now offline) and used in our 2015 study: all 10,253,694 scaffolds and the chloroplast.
# This mirror (CNCB-NGDC) and Plant GARDEN (plantgarden.jp, t3329.G001/Pabies01-genome.fa.gz, block
# gzip) serve the same text; run_bench.py records the sha256 of the decompressed text as well.
